def find(parent, i):
    if parent[i] == i:
        return i
    parent[i] = find(parent, parent[i])
    return parent[i]

    rootX = find(parent, x)
    rootY = find(parent, y)

        if rank[rootX] > rank[rootY]:
            parent[rootY] = rootX
        elif rank[rootX] < rank[rootY]:
            parent[rootX] = rootY
        else:
